title: Refugees moved as cargo in conex containers

tellings.quote: According to Barber, this is how they moved them. These refugees aren't being rescued, they are the cargo.

plain: Around 2004, near Coyame in Mexico, people described as refugees were moved inside conex containers, the standard steel shipping boxes, not as people being rescued but as the cargo itself. Michels gives this as the account of a man named Jake Barber, drawing on a book called Sentinels of Ether: "These refugees aren't being rescued, they are the cargo." He does not say more about who the people were or where they were taken.
